# V0.9.2

## 中文说明

### 新增功能

- 在“招投标”下新增“可研报告”，提供项目创建与管理、项目资料录入、附件导入、资料分析、报告目录生成、关键参数整理、正文生成与校审、整篇预览和 Word 导出的一体化流程。
- 可研报告目录支持模板、目标字数和知识库参考配置，并支持多级目录展开/折叠、编辑、增删和 AI 调整。
- 正文支持按小节后台生成、暂停恢复、缺失补写、单节重生成、人工化校审及章节状态跟踪；页面切换不会中断任务。
- 新增正文配图配置，可组合使用 AI 生图、技术图谱和 Mermaid 图，并在预览与 Word 导出中处理相关图片。
- 新增可研报告项目重置、返回首页、暗黑模式适配和独立本地工作区存储。

### 修复与优化

- 统一可研报告六个步骤的界面布局、进度反馈、目录树、编辑预览和底部操作栏样式，使其与技术方案流程保持一致。
- 修复预览、全屏、目录设置、目录折叠、AI 调整、正文配图配置保存和 Word 导出等交互问题。
- 改进生成与校审进度展示，避免任务完成或无待补写章节时进度停留在 1%，并在目录中标识正在校审的章节。
- 修复暗黑模式下预览表头、更新下载进度区域及相关弹窗样式。
- 修复 Word 导出中残留 Markdown 加粗标记的问题，并约束正文 Markdown 标题不再生成“一、”“（一）”或“(一)”等重复序号。
- Word 导出改为底部功能按钮触发，增加导出进度弹窗、完成路径展示和打开文件目录能力。
- 更新 Agnes AI 中国大陆站与国际站注册地址及跳转链接。

### 验证

- 通过 Electron Main 服务语法检查。
- 通过可研报告 Store 与后台任务验证脚本。
- 通过 TypeScript 与 Vite 生产构建。

## English Notes

### New features

- Added Feasibility Reports under Bidding, covering project management, project data entry, document import, source analysis, outline generation, key-parameter preparation, content generation and review, full-document preview, and Word export.
- Added outline settings for templates, target word counts, and knowledge-base references, together with expandable multi-level trees, editing, insertion, deletion, and AI-assisted adjustment.
- Added background section generation with pause/resume, missing-section completion, per-section regeneration, humanized review, and live chapter status tracking without interrupting tasks during page navigation.
- Added configurable illustrations using AI-generated images, technical diagrams, and Mermaid diagrams, including preview and Word export handling.
- Added project reset, return-to-home navigation, dark-mode support, and isolated local workspaces for feasibility-report projects.

### Fixes and improvements

- Unified all six feasibility-report steps with the technical-plan layout, including progress feedback, outline trees, editing/preview panels, and the floating action bar.
- Fixed inactive preview, fullscreen, outline settings, tree folding, AI outline adjustment, illustration configuration saving, and Word export interactions.
- Improved generation and review progress so completed or no-op completion tasks no longer remain at 1%, and reviewing chapters are visibly marked in the outline.
- Fixed dark-theme colors for preview table headers, update-download progress, and related dialogs.
- Fixed leaked Markdown bold markers in Word exports and constrained generated Markdown headings from adding duplicate Chinese ordinal prefixes such as “一、”, “（一）”, or “(一)”.
- Moved Word export to the bottom action bar and added an export-progress dialog, completed file location display, and open-folder action.
- Updated registration labels and links for the Agnes AI mainland China and international services.

### Validation

- Passed Electron Main service syntax checks.
- Passed feasibility-report store and background-task verification scripts.
- Passed the TypeScript and Vite production build.
